title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Encore Eyes a Box Office Milestone
excerpt:
An extended rerelease is reported for December 4, 2026.
The article projects a possible domestic box-office first.
body_md:
A new report says Spider-Man: Brand New Day will return to theaters on December 4, 2026, in an Encore edition featuring approximately ten minutes of additional footage. The material reportedly includes a previously cut appearance by Rosario Dawson's Claire Temple.

The article puts the film's domestic gross at about $959 million and argues that another $41 million would take it past the unprecedented $1 billion domestic threshold. It compares that target with the performance of the Avengers: Endgame Encore rerelease.

The milestone remains a projection, not an achieved result. Suggestions that Marvel might release similar expanded editions of other films are speculative editorial ideas rather than confirmed studio plans.
